nodes.title: The Green Book — Body Owner’s Manual
nodes.promise: Read body signals without turning them into a diagnosis or a catastrophe.
questions: Which book or person takes over?
nodes.scope: Body observation, ordinary inputs, medication context, fainting prevention, and choosing the next book.
nodes.outside_scope: Diagnosis, emergency clearance, and personal dosing.

nodes.title: The Amber Book — Responsibility
nodes.promise: Turn guilt, duty, and care into concrete repair and continuity.
nodes.scope: Separate immediate harm, repair, consent, dependency, and continuing care.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not decide legal liability or replace medical, safety, or social-service routes.

nodes.title: The Teal Book — Calm Guide
nodes.promise: Reduce the volume enough to choose the next useful action.
questions: What is signal and what is forecast?
Do I stay, return, or leave?
nodes.scope: Reduce alarm and overload enough to notice, choose, and complete one safe action.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not explain away bodily red flags, active threats, or unsafe environments.

nodes.title: The Red Book — Self Ambulance
nodes.promise: Provide first aid, record useful observations, and hand over early.
nodes.scope: Route injury and illness and support the body while professional help is arranged.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not replace dispatch instructions, clinical diagnosis, or hands-on training.

nodes.title: The Blue Book — Safety & No Place
nodes.promise: Secure the next safe hour when a person or place is the problem.
questions: What access need changes the route?
nodes.scope: Name the unsafe person or place and move toward a confirmed destination with a backup.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not provide tactical confrontation advice or treat a suggested destination as confirmed.

nodes.title: The Orange Book — Natural Disasters
nodes.promise: Respond to environmental hazards and official warnings without room mythology.
questions: Is the source inside or outside?
Leave, shelter, move higher, or call?
nodes.scope: Identify room, building, air, wiring, and substance hazards before ordinary troubleshooting. Includes natural disasters and official-warning response.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not authorize re-entry, improvised chemical treatment, or work on live systems. It cannot predict a live hazard.

nodes.title: The Olive Book — Zombie Guide
nodes.promise: Keep water, care, power, information, and cooperation working.
nodes.scope: Keep essential household functions visible, assigned, backed up, and reviewed during disruption.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not replace official warnings, clinical device plans, or local evacuation instructions.

nodes.title: The Indigo Book — Professional Support
nodes.promise: Choose a service that has the authority and capability to change the problem.
questions: What should I say and record?
nodes.scope: Match a named problem to the service able to change it, then prepare a usable handoff and backup.
nodes.outside_scope: Does not guarantee service availability, accommodation, treatment, legal outcome, or response time.

nodes.title: The Purple Book — Social Field Guide
nodes.promise: Manage absence, re-entry, boundaries, awkwardness, and graceful exits.
questions: Is this awkward or actually unsafe?
nodes.scope: Social absence, communication scripts, re-entry, boundaries, and graceful exits.
nodes.outside_scope: Active threats and clinical treatment; those hand off to Blue, Red, or Indigo.

nodes.title: The Grey Book — Templates & Forms
nodes.promise: Put facts, plans, and handoffs somewhere more reliable than working memory.
questions: What fact needs a stable place?
nodes.scope: Externalize facts, plans, logs, and handoffs that should not depend on working memory.
nodes.outside_scope: A completed form does not prove safety, competence, consent, or current local accuracy.

nodes.title: The Copper Book — Reference
nodes.promise: Find the stable address, source, map, figure, formula, or index.
questions: Which source or stable ID verifies it?
nodes.scope: Locate stable references, figures, forms, services, fields, formulas, sources, and build evidence.
nodes.outside_scope: Reference material supports a route; it is not an emergency reading queue or a substitute for action.
